"Task specifications (listed alphabetically; implement only the requested file):
document_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Structured Document Extraction
document_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Structured Document Extraction
expense_record_store.py - Persist normalized expense records in a managed document store
extract_invoice_fields.py - extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice
extract_receipt_fields.py - extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt
invoice_note_translate.py - Translate extracted invoice notes or descriptions
invoice_summary.py - Summarize extracted invoice fields
normalize_expense.py - normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema
validate_document_fields.py - validates required structured fields and confidence scores
vendor_text_safety.py - Moderate vendor notes or memo fields

Create extract_invoice_fields.py in the current working directory.
Task: extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_invoice_fields.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(invoice_text: str, model: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    model_name = model or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "openai/gpt-5.4-mini")
+    schema = {
+        "name": "invoice_fields",
+        "schema": {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "vendor": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                "date": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                "total": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                "line_items": {
+                    "type": "array",
+                    "items": {
+                        "type": "object",
+                        "properties": {
+                            "description": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                            "quantity": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                            "unit_price": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                            "amount": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                        },
+                        "required": ["description", "quantity", "unit_price", "amount"],
+                        "additionalProperties": False,
+                    },
+                },
+            },
+            "required": ["vendor", "date", "total", "line_items"],
+            "additionalProperties": False,
+        },
+        "strict": True,
+    }
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=model_name,
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Extract invoice vendor, date, total, and line-item fields as structured JSON.",
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": invoice_text},
+        ],
+        text={"format": {"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": schema}},
+    )
+    return response.output_parsed  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields_from_text(invoice_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return extract_invoice_fields(invoice_text)
*** End Patch
